titleJapanese: 秘伝のラーメンスープ
summary: Daiki visits a legendary noodle shop in Kyoto to taste the rich tonkotsu broth boiled for twenty hours.
author: Daiki
storyJapanese: 京都の路地に古いラーメン屋があります。店主は毎朝早く起きてスープを仕込みます。豚骨と野菜を二十時間じっくり煮込みます。熱々の丼から香ばしい湯気が立ち上ります。一口飲むと、深い旨味が口いっぱいに広がりました。
storyEnglish: In an alley in Kyoto, there is an old ramen shop. The master wakes up early every morning to prepare the soup. He simmers pork bones and vegetables slowly for twenty hours. A savory steam rises from the piping hot bowl. Taking one sip, a deep umami flavor spread throughout his mouth.
